# Platinum Flooring LLC

> Family-owned flooring store and installation company in Severn, Maryland, serving Glen Burnie, Hanover, Odenton and the Greater Baltimore area since 1999. Licensed & insured.

## Services
- Carpet installation
- Hardwood flooring (solid & engineered)
- Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) & luxury vinyl tile
- Hardwood refinishing (sand, stain, seal)
- Sheet vinyl & laminate
- Commercial flooring
